articles.summary: Multi-year partnership includes extensive brand presence at Tropicana Field and gameday broadcast TAMPA, FL – July 16, 2024 – Amerant Bank, Florida’s bank of choice with a growing presence across the Greater Tampa area, today announced a multi-year strategic partnership with the Tampa Bay Rays making Amerant Bank the “Official Bank” of the team. articles.title: AMERANT BANK NAMED THE OFFICIAL BANK OF THE TAMPA BAY RAYS
